title: WorryCourtroomCase.cs
summary: The data for one Worry Courtroom trial, as a ScriptableObject: the worry, the evidence cards, and the answer lists for each round. Create more from the Assets menu.

notes.match: public enum ThinkingTrap { None, MindReading, FortuneTelling, AllOrNothing, Catastrophizing, EmotionalReasoning, Labeling }
notes.text: The six thinking traps a guess card can be. A dropdown in the Inspector, so there are no typos.
One card in the prosecution round: text, 'Is Fact', and which trap it is when it isn't.
One answer button: its text, whether it is the helpful one, and the explanation shown when it is picked wrongly.
Adds Assets ▸ Create ▸ Mindscape ▸ Worry Courtroom Case.
Prosecution: shown one at a time and sorted into fact or guess.
Defence: the player must pick the number of good facts set in Rules (three by default).
The names and plain-language explanations of each trap, shown when a guess is spotted.
Optional per-case wording for the screen text. Blank means use the text on the component.
Looks up a trap's display text, falling back to the enum name if the list has no entry.
